title: sin(1) is nonnegative: 0 <= sin(1)
statement: CReal.sinOne_alternating_lower (this batch) at m := 0: sumRange sinTerm (0+0) is ι-defeq to zero (both Nat.add's and CReal.sumRange's own base cases), so the general bracket specializes to the sign bound for free, no Rat/CReal arithmetic at all. This is the REAL [0, ...] lower bound on sin(1) established over the constructed reals, distinct from any loose interval bound recorded elsewhere.
